title: Thinking on Loyalty & Customer Experiences
summary: Kahran and Divya try to find what actually generates brand loyalty — using Nike Run Club, BTS fandom, JK Rowling's residual goodwill, and the way Indian consumer values have moved from cheapest-wins to experience-first. They land on shared values between brand and customer, plus multiple weld points to engage with the brand, as the real engine of loyalty.

intents.display: to understand what actually builds customer loyalty to a brand
